questions.question: What does 'வணக்கம்' (Vanakkam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'வணக்கம்' (Vanakkam) is the universal Tamil greeting meaning Hello or Greetings.

questions.question: What does 'தண்ணீர்' (Thanneer) mean?
questions.explanation: 'தண்ணீர்' means water in Tamil. It is one of the most essential Tamil words.

questions.question: What does 'அம்மா' (Amma) mean?
questions.explanation: 'அம்மா' means Mother in Tamil. It is used lovingly across Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: What does 'பள்ளி' (Palli) mean?
questions.explanation: 'பள்ளி' means school in Tamil. Children attend பள்ளி to study.

questions.question: How do you say 'one' in Tamil?
questions.explanation: 'ஒன்று' (Ondru) means one. Numbers: ஒன்று (1), இரண்டு (2), மூன்று (3).

questions.question: What does 'வீடு' (Veedu) mean?
questions.explanation: 'வீடு' means house or home in Tamil.

questions.question: What does 'நன்றி' (Nandri) mean?
questions.explanation: 'நன்றி' means Thank you in Tamil. It is a polite expression of gratitude.

questions.question: What does 'ஆம்' (Aam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ஆம்' means Yes in Tamil. 'இல்லை' (Illai) means No.

questions.question: What does 'மரம்' (Maram) mean?
questions.explanation: 'மரம்' means tree in Tamil. 'மரங்கள்' (Marangal) is the plural form.
